concerns.text: FR-001 requires matching subjects across the HCP resting‑state fMRI dataset and an external Music Emotion Rating (MER) dataset using the HCP Subject ID or a deterministic key based on demographics. The specification provides no evidence that the external MER dataset contains overlapping IDs or that demographic‑based deterministic matching can reliably identify the same individuals. This unverified assumption makes the behavioral outcome (MER score) not truly independent of the neural predictors and threatens the core validity of any reported brain‑behavior relationships.

The spec treats the MER construct as a single ‘MER total score’ (BehavioralScore) without confirming that the source dataset uses a validated musical‑emotion rating instrument or that the total score is psychometrically sound. Lack of construct validity for the behavioral measure means any observed correlations could reflect measurement artefacts rather than genuine brain‑behavior links.
